dedupe_keys.name: center for global sustainability nickel smelter dataset indonesia

description: This dataset is an inventory of nickel smelting facilities across Indonesia compiled by the Center for Global Sustainability at the University of Maryland. The spreadsheet read on 2026-09-26 has 106 rows and 33 columns: smelter and industrial park name, ownership and headquarters, coordinates with a location status and notes, regency and province, process (47 RKEF, 20 HPAL, 11 blast furnace and others), input and output capacity in tonnes, output product, nickel metal equivalent, captive power by source in MW (diesel, grid, coal, gas, hydro, solar), archived source links and a 2025 status. It was published in January 2025 by the centre's team under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one Excel file. Coverage is Indonesia. Caveats: some rows are mines without a confirmed smelter, several processes are unknown, and figures come from media and company sources, not audited returns. For simulation it gives plant locations, capacities and captive coal power to model nickel supply chains, grid dependence and disruption of battery mineral supply. Related catalogue records include the USGS simulated copper, cobalt and nickel markets and the EV battery cathode critical mineral flows data.
